dict.string: Telemetry I/O reads an NDEF tag when you start a tag session. Tag contents are not stored.
Telemetry I/O listens for nearby Bluetooth LE advertisements to visualize received signal strength. It does not connect to advertisers.
Telemetry I/O measures brightness, color and camera exposure when enabled. Frames are processed locally and discarded.
Telemetry I/O visualizes your position, speed, heading and accuracy in the foreground. Position stays local unless you export a capture.
Telemetry I/O measures audio level and spectrum when enabled. Audio is processed locally without recording.
Telemetry I/O visualizes motion, magnetic field, air pressure and walking measurements when you enable their sources.
Telemetry I/O can visualize distance to a participating nearby peer in a configured ranging session.
